title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 8: Your Own Voice

planning.storytellingVoice: Immediate drama: a confession changes a confrontation into a decision about power and accountability.
planning.sourceBoundary: Episode 8: eastern station manual activation request. Carry tower injury/beacon and relay playback/evidence outcomes; discover who requested the repetition without restoring any losses.
planning.dramaticChange: Jonathan demands an answer but learns to distinguish public accountability from promising forgiveness on others’ behalf.
planning.earlyCare: Ren first warns strangers away from a falling door and notices An needs a safe place.
planning.desire: Find the person responsible and prevent another unauthorized replay.
planning.obstacle: Removing all control also silences new calls for help; keeping it requires trust or a tested limited control.
planning.englishNarrationPurpose: Context and optional English help only; narrative stays Mandarin.
choicesAndCallbacks: Direct question versus move to shelter: distinct confession responses.
Inspect/test independent circuits or hear fear of losing trust.

Take all-control key: old requests blocked and new help disabled; trust: new help survives but replay risk remains; inspected shared: old switch locked and key removed, new calls live, interim shared watch.
Personal account versus written record: neither grants forgiveness.
sceneActivities: Ren braces a damaged door with clothing; both step to safe wall on either approach.
Jonathan crouches for inspection; An advises from outside on all injury states.
An interrupts at door movement; everyone retreats to separate outside shelter.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Plain questions, firmer short demands; attentive stillness after confession.
actingSignature.An: Precise consequences, independent dissent; watches from safe place, never climbs or lifts.
actingSignature.Ren: Practical safety warnings become admissions; clenched clothing and a quiet listener turn.

planning.listenerTurn: Pair → mother never consented → Ren silent holding coat → pair. Pair → answer with own voice → Ren asks whether anyone will listen → reader-controlled breathing beat → no promised forgiveness.
planning.payoff: Ren admits manually activating repeated requests; authority over old playback and new requests is decided. No restoration of prior records, water, people or equipment.
planning.freshQuestion: Ren controlled voices, not western water flow. Who controls the water?
